text:
Nora (PM): Dropping a quick iteration for the org roles page. New concern: mobile responsiveness and where to put 'Invite' CTA on narrow screens. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mobile123/org-roles-mobile. Please flag urgent accessibility/copy issues.
Ethan (Design): For mobile, move Invite CTA into a sticky bottom bar to avoid scroll hunting. Roles matrix should collapse into an accordion per role with 'Permissions' and 'Members' tabs. Avoid horizontal scroll.
Pri (Eng): Sticky bar is fine but watch layering with native mobile keyboards. We'll ensure safe-area insets. Accordion nodes should lazy-render members list to keep perf.
Sam (Security): On mobile, SSO enforcement cannot be easily reversible; make the action a two-step confirmation with a typed org name to confirm. Also ensure the SSO toggle has clear label: 'Require SSO sign-in'.
Bea (Support): On the 'Invite' flow, mobile users often miss the expiry option. Make expiry a visible dropdown in the invite flow rather than hidden. Also the email input should support pasting multiple comma-separated addresses.
Max (QA): Accessibility checks: accordion headers must be buttons with aria-expanded; ensure each member row is reachable by keyboard and swipe gestures don't break focus. Verify reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Ethan (Design): Copy tweak: change 'Invite teammates' toast to 'Invitations queued' for bulk CSV uploads. And 'Role: Admin' label should be 'Admin (full access)' in compact view.
Pri (Eng): CSV upload on mobile will be fallback to file picker. We'll show mapping UI for columns after upload.
Sam (Security): Audit log nav: mobile should present a condensed filter bar with 'By user / By action' toggles. Export not available on mobile (admin only) — show disabled CTA with tooltip 'Use desktop to export'.
Nora (PM): Ok action list: Ethan update mobile frames with sticky invite CTA and accordion; Pri add lazy rendering and CSV mapping; Sam produce SSO confirm text and org-name typed confirmation; Max run mobile a11y pass; Bea draft support note about mobile invite expiry. Bot: create branch for mobile changes.
bot-deploy: Branch `mobile/org-roles-v1` created by nora.
Bea (Support): I'll compile common customer questions about invite expiries and paste here in a bit.
Ethan (Design): Uploaded updated mobile frames — adding keyboard area padding.
Max (QA): I'll start quick tests on iOS simulator after lunch.
Nora (PM): Great team, please post any remaining small word changes here, will merge into the ticket by EOD.
